note: baseline = what it measured; budget = the ceiling (~3× time, 1.5× size). Re-record with: node tools/check-perf.mjs --set

frame.on: Apple M4 / macOS 26.1 / Chromium preview pane, dense-year3 on the farm at noon, 1227 frames
frame.caveat: Driven by hand (loop() called in a tight run with requestAnimationFrame stubbed out) because the harness browser throttles rAF to ~1fps. That measures the same WORK a real frame does, but not vsync, compositing, or a real GPU. `worst` is the first frame plus GC, not a steady-state stall. Re-measure on a real window with: await perfProbe(5)
